terms.definition: Chunk-autoregressive video generation with within-chunk continuous flow denoising and block-causal inter-chunk conditioning.
terms.ambiguity_notes: It is not frame-by-frame or discrete-token autoregression.

terms.definition: The number of chunks concurrently progressing through staggered denoising stages.
terms.ambiguity_notes: It differs from total clip chunk count and KV history range.

terms.definition: Online packing of variable-duration and variable-resolution samples into a fixed token-capacity training context.
terms.ambiguity_notes: The 4M-token capacity describes a packed batch/context, not one default video.

terms.definition: Steady-state time per one-second output chunk after the first chunk.
terms.ambiguity_notes: It is distinct from time to first chunk.

terms.definition: A distributed irregular-attention stack combining flexible FlashAttention, load-balanced dispatch, group collectives, and overlap.
terms.ambiguity_notes: It denotes more than a single CUDA attention kernel.

symbols.meaning: Latent of chunk i at flow time t.
symbols.ambiguity_notes: The paper uses t=0 for clean and t=1 for noise.
With 4x temporal VAE compression this represents 24 raw frames.

symbols.meaning: Visual DiT token count per chunk.
symbols.ambiguity_notes: It excludes text, padding, CFG branches, and replicated KV reads.

symbols.meaning: Total generated chunks in a clip.
symbols.ambiguity_notes: It is not the concurrent denoising window size.

design_rationales.concrete_problem: Whole-video bidirectional denoising cannot naturally stream and becomes expensive for long videos.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Block-causal chunks permit playback and KV reuse after each one-second unit while retaining within-chunk parallel denoising.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Global bidirectional video DiT can use future context but lacks the same streaming and bounded-history properties.

design_rationales.concrete_problem: Recomputing all previously generated chunks increases steady-state latency and history cost.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Completed clean chunks provide cached keys and values; a finite range bounds steady-state work.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Full history may improve long-range consistency but grows memory and attention cost with video duration.

design_rationales.concrete_problem: Training on perfect clean history creates exposure bias relative to imperfect generated history.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Adding up to 5% noise to context chunks trains the model to tolerate accumulated generation errors.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Self-forcing would more closely match inference but costs additional sampling during training.

design_rationales.concrete_problem: Packed 4M-token contexts with heterogeneous masks cause load imbalance and redundant communication.
design_rationales.causal_mechanism: Flexible FlashAttention, optimized dispatch, group collectives, and adaptive overlap balance work and hide communication.
design_rationales.alternatives_tradeoffs: Generic Ulysses or ring attention is simpler but may underutilize ranks under irregular packed masks.

limitations.reason: The public repository contains inference code but not full training data/code or the complete 24-GPU production scheduler and telemetry stack.
limitations.effect_on_conclusions: Training-scale, data, 4M-token packing, and production-utilization claims remain author-reported rather than independently reproduced.
